title: SonicVista
description: Spatial awareness, particularly awareness of distant environmental scenes known as the Vista space, is crucial and contributes to the cognitive and aesthetic needs of People with Visual Impairments (PVI). In this project, we investigate AI-based audio generative models to design sounds that can create awareness and experience of vista-space scenes.
